# MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (synthetic test document)

Between Example Telematics Co. ("Company") and Mr. Consultant (an individual, "Consultant").

1. Confidential Information includes all technical, commercial and financial information disclosed by either party, in any form, and remains confidential in perpetuity.
2. Consultant shall not, for a period of three (3) years after the end of the engagement, engage in any business in the Kingdom that competes with the Company.
3. In any dispute, the prevailing party shall recover its attorneys' fees and costs from the other party.
4. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The courts of London, England shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
5. Standard carve-outs apply: information that is public, already known, independently developed, received from a third party, or required by law to be disclosed.
